note: Offline translations used by FixtureLLM for languages outside the vetted catalog (NotifyAgent). Each has a back-translation so the fact check runs exactly as in live mode.

entries.source: $150 has been sent to your Venmo. We hope it helps. Take care.
entries.translation: $150 ont été envoyés sur votre Venmo. Nous espérons que cela vous aidera. Prenez soin de vous.
entries.backTranslation: $150 was sent to your Venmo. We hope this will help you. Take care of yourself.

entries.source: We sent $100 to PayPal, but it has not been claimed yet. To get it, open PayPal or sign up with the same email or phone number you gave us. Reply here if you need help.
entries.translation: Nous avons envoyé $100 via PayPal, mais l'argent n'a pas encore été réclamé. Pour le recevoir, ouvrez PayPal ou inscrivez-vous avec la même adresse e-mail ou le même numéro de téléphone que vous nous avez donnés. Répondez ici si vous avez besoin d'aide.
entries.backTranslation: We sent $100 via PayPal, but the money has not been claimed yet. To receive it, open PayPal or sign up with the same email address or phone number you gave us. Reply here if you need help.

entries.source: Here is what I understood. Please tell me if it is right:
entries.translation: Voici ce que j'ai compris. Dites-moi si c'est juste :
entries.backTranslation: Here is what I understood. Tell me if it is right:

entries.source: Here is what I understood. Please tell me if it is right:
entries.translation: 제가 이해한 내용은 이렇습니다. 맞는지 알려 주세요:
entries.backTranslation: This is what I understood. Please let me know if it is right:

entries.source: Here is what I understood. Please tell me if it is right:
entries.translation: Вот как мы поняли вашу просьбу. Скажите, пожалуйста, всё ли верно:
entries.backTranslation: Here is how we understood your request. Please tell us if everything is correct:

entries.source: Here is what I understood. Please tell me if it is right:
entries.translation: Ito ang pagkakaintindi ko. Pakisabi kung tama:
entries.backTranslation: This is what I understood. Please say if it is correct:

entries.source: If approved, the money goes to your {wallet}: {receiver}.
entries.translation: 승인되면 {wallet} 계정 {receiver}(으)로 돈을 보내 드립니다.
entries.backTranslation: If approved, we will send the money to {wallet} account {receiver}.

entries.source: If approved, the money goes to your {wallet}: {receiver}.
entries.translation: Если просьбу одобрят, деньги придут на ваш {wallet}: {receiver}.
entries.backTranslation: If the request is approved, the money will come to your {wallet}: {receiver}.

entries.source: If approved, the money goes to your {wallet}: {receiver}.
entries.translation: Si c'est approuvé, l'argent sera envoyé sur votre {wallet} : {receiver}.
entries.backTranslation: If it is approved, the money will be sent to your {wallet}: {receiver}.

entries.source: If approved, the money goes to your {wallet}: {receiver}.
entries.translation: Kapag naaprubahan, ipapadala ang pera sa iyong {wallet}: {receiver}.
entries.backTranslation: When approved, the money will be sent to your {wallet}: {receiver}.

entries.source: Where should we send the money? You can give us a PayPal email or a Venmo username.
entries.translation: 돈을 어디로 보내 드릴까요? PayPal 이메일이나 Venmo 사용자 이름을 알려 주세요.
entries.backTranslation: Where should we send the money? Please tell us a PayPal email or a Venmo username.

entries.source: Where should we send the money? You can give us a PayPal email or a Venmo username.
entries.translation: Куда отправить деньги? Напишите email вашего PayPal или имя пользователя в Venmo.
entries.backTranslation: Where should we send the money? Write the email of your PayPal or your username in Venmo.

entries.source: Where should we send the money? You can give us a PayPal email or a Venmo username.
entries.translation: Où devons-nous envoyer l'argent ? Vous pouvez nous donner une adresse e-mail PayPal ou un nom d'utilisateur Venmo.
entries.backTranslation: Where should we send the money? You can give us a PayPal email address or a Venmo username.

entries.source: Where should we send the money? You can give us a PayPal email or a Venmo username.
entries.translation: Saan namin ipapadala ang pera? Puwede mong ibigay ang email mo sa PayPal o ang username mo sa Venmo.
entries.backTranslation: Where will we send the money? You can give your PayPal email or your Venmo username.

entries.source: How many people live in your home, including you?
entries.translation: 본인을 포함해서 집에 몇 분이 사시나요?
entries.backTranslation: Including yourself, how many people live in your home?

entries.source: How many people live in your home, including you?
entries.translation: Сколько человек живёт у вас дома, включая вас?
entries.backTranslation: How many people live in your home, including you?

entries.source: How many people live in your home, including you?
entries.translation: Combien de personnes vivent chez vous, vous compris ?
entries.backTranslation: How many people live in your home, including you?

entries.source: How many people live in your home, including you?
entries.translation: Ilang tao ang nakatira sa bahay ninyo, kasama ka?
entries.backTranslation: How many people live in your house, including you?

entries.source: Could you tell me a little more about what you need help with?
entries.translation: 어떤 도움이 필요하신지 조금 더 말씀해 주시겠어요?
entries.backTranslation: Could you tell me a little more about what help you need?

entries.source: Could you tell me a little more about what you need help with?
entries.translation: Расскажите, пожалуйста, чуть подробнее, с чем вам нужна помощь?
entries.backTranslation: Please tell us in a bit more detail what you need help with?

entries.source: Could you tell me a little more about what you need help with?
entries.translation: Pouvez-vous m'en dire un peu plus sur ce dont vous avez besoin ?
entries.backTranslation: Can you tell me a little more about what you need?

entries.source: Could you tell me a little more about what you need help with?
entries.translation: Puwede mo bang sabihin nang kaunti pa kung anong tulong ang kailangan mo?
entries.backTranslation: Can you say a little more about what help you need?

entries.source: Sorry, I want to be sure I understood. Could you tell me again what you need?
entries.translation: 죄송합니다. 제대로 이해했는지 확인하고 싶어요. 무엇이 필요하신지 다시 말씀해 주시겠어요?
entries.backTranslation: Sorry. I want to check that I understood correctly. Could you tell me again what you need?

entries.source: Sorry, I want to be sure I understood. Could you tell me again what you need?
entries.translation: Извините, хотим убедиться, что всё поняли правильно. Повторите, пожалуйста, что вам нужно?
entries.backTranslation: Sorry, we want to make sure we understood everything correctly. Please repeat what you need?

entries.source: Sorry, I want to be sure I understood. Could you tell me again what you need?
entries.translation: Pardon, je veux être sûr d'avoir bien compris. Pouvez-vous me redire ce dont vous avez besoin ?
entries.backTranslation: Sorry, I want to be sure I understood. Can you tell me again what you need?

entries.source: Sorry, I want to be sure I understood. Could you tell me again what you need?
entries.translation: Pasensya na, gusto kong makasigurong naintindihan ko. Puwede mo bang sabihin ulit kung ano ang kailangan mo?
entries.backTranslation: Sorry, I want to be sure I understood. Can you say again what you need?

entries.source: What neighborhood or street do you live on?
entries.translation: 어느 동네나 거리에 사시나요?
entries.backTranslation: What neighborhood or street do you live on?

entries.source: What neighborhood or street do you live on?
entries.translation: В каком районе или на какой улице вы живёте?
entries.backTranslation: In what neighborhood or on what street do you live?

entries.source: What neighborhood or street do you live on?
entries.translation: Dans quel quartier ou quelle rue habitez-vous ?
entries.backTranslation: In what neighborhood or what street do you live?

entries.source: What neighborhood or street do you live on?
entries.translation: Saang lugar o kalye ka nakatira?
entries.backTranslation: What area or street do you live on?
